result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on the two remaining Story 4 blockers and directly touched fork surfaces. Both prior findings are resolved, focused tests pass, and configured story/epic gates pass.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: packages/pi-lhc/src/lifecycle/fork.ts:29-47 now reads previousSessionFile entries, compares previous entry ids against current session entries, and checks parentId links to previous ids. packages/pi-lhc/test/lifecycle/fork.test.ts:83-127 adds hook-absent fallback coverage with previousSessionFile plus current sessionManager entries carrying id/parentId chain evidence.

packages/pi-lhc/src/index.ts:325-342 now records diagnostics and returns on fork thread creation or instance init failure in the hook path. packages/pi-lhc/src/index.ts:385-400 does the same in the fallback fork path. The normal launch fallthrough is gone for those fork setup failures.

verified: AC-3.1/TC-3.1: fork creates a new thread from session_before_fork hook data without depending on reason code, source event read-back remains unchanged, and hook-absent fallback is covered with session-tree id/parentId evidence.
AC-3.2/TC-3.2: fork seeding replays source events through LHC intake to the target and focused tests verify seeded read-back through the fork point.
AC-3.3/TC-3.3: v1 does not copy derived forms; focused tests show target work requeues pending, then derives ready independently.
